forcedChoices.reason: The English uses the short-scale billion; Spanish billón means 10^12.
The English 'Two billion and seventy' is 2 000 000 070; the Spanish keeps the words in the same form.

forcedChoices.reason: 'ultimates' is a noun for the ultimate (absonite) level; the neuter 'lo último' keeps the level sense without adding words, and it avoids 'los últimos' (the last ones).
Spanish forces a gender on the place name with an article; feminine follows 'la' used for proper names of worlds and regions in natural usage.
'hide and seek' has different names by country (escondite, escondidas); a neutral phrase keeps the meaning for all readers.
